info.title: Sotto API
info.description: Core /api/v1 surface consumed by the Sotto terminal client. Generated from the Zod contract registry in @sotto/shared.

bearerAuth.description: A long-lived Sotto API key (sk_sotto_...) minted via /api/v1/auth/pair/redeem.

playClaimantProof.name: X-Sotto-Play-Proof
playClaimantProof.description: A private proof for one pending game invitation and credential delivery. A room code or request ID is not this proof.
